'''Lefrani''' was a [[gas giant]] [[planet]] located in the [[Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]'<ref name="CL" /> [[Western Reaches]] portion,<ref name="Location" /> in the [[Mustafar system]],<ref name="CL" /> at grid square L-19<ref name="TFABG" /> of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Rebel Dossier">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Rebel Dossier]]''</ref> In close [[orbit]] of the small world of [[Mustafar]], Lefrani was in a constant state of tug-of-war with a neighboring [[gas]] giant, [[Jestefad]], both in an attempt to make Mustafar into their [[moon]] with their [[Gravity|gravitational]] pull. As a result, Mustafar was effectively transformed into an unstable world of [[magma]] and rock.<ref name="CL" />

Several [[Millennium|millennia]] ago, Lefrani and Jestefad were pulled out of their orbit of the [[star]] [[Priate]] during a cataclysmic struggle between the [[Jedi]] and [[Sith]]. As a result, both gas giants were pulled close to the smaller world of Mustafar, suspending the planet on an erratic path between their gravitational pulls.<ref name="BMF 17" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lefrani first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="ROTS date">{{SW|url=news/critical-opinion-revenge-of-the-sith-original-reviews|text=Critical Opinion: ''Revenge of the Sith'' Original Reviews}}</ref> The planet was first identified in new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 17|seventeeth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine,<ref name="BMF 17" /> published around [[April 29]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BMFdates|17}}</ref> [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]] was first identified in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] in [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], a reference book published by [[Dorling Kindersley]]<ref name="Complete Locations 2005">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'', 2005 edition]]</ref> on [[October 17]], 2005.<ref name="CL 2005 date">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20050314.html|text=DK: The Ultimate in ''Star Wars'' Guides}}</ref>
